command:
echo "== date"; date -u; echo "== base (task asked)"; uname -a; nproc; free -m; df -h / /workspace /cache 2>&1; go version 2>&1 || true; python3 --version; gcc --version 2>&1 | head -1 || true; nvidia-smi 2>&1 | head -2 || true
echo "== whoami"; id; echo "== cgroup limits"; for f in memory.max memory.current cpu.max pids.max pids.current memory.swap.max; do echo "$f=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/$f 2>&1)"; done
echo "== tools"; for t in tmux git curl wget make gcc g++ cmake nice ionice timeout pip3 pip node cargo rustc; do printf "%s=%s\n" $t "$(command -v $t || echo MISSING)"; done
echo "== load"; cat /proc/loadavg
echo "== zombies visible in container"; ps -eo stat= | grep -c '^Z' || true
echo "== network"; for u in https://github.com https://pypi.org/simple/ https://huggingface.co https://proxy.golang.org https://go.dev/dl/; do printf "%s -> " $u; curl -s -o /dev/null -m 15 -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s\n" $u || echo FAIL; done
echo "== omega repo reachability"; timeout 30 git ls-remote https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/oMEGAcV1.git HEAD 2>&1 | head -2 || true
echo "== workspace"; ls /workspace | head -40; du -sh /workspace 2>/dev/null | tail -1
